skill_name: Summarize the history of the US Democratic Party
workflow: The Democratic Party has its origin in the Democratic-Republican Party founded by Thomas Jefferson and James Madison in the 1790s. It is the oldest political party in the United States, and has been the nation's main center-left political party since the 19th century.
